## Specific task description

Task instruction: Open the medium laptop with silver body using the right arm.

Task description: The target is the medium silver laptop just right of center on the table. Use the right arm to open its lid further from its current slightly open position.

Success criteria: The cover is opened to at least 40% of its full travel, while the right end effector remains near the notebook’s designated opening reference position.

## Execution tips

- Prefer contacting the middle of the free edge of the top cover away from the hinge, avoiding the corners and placing the pad on the frame to reduce twisting from off-center force.
- If grasping the lid, open slightly wider than its thickness and use the visible gap to confirm one finger inside and one outside. Avoid merely pressing its edge or grasping the base along with it.
- As the lid flips open, move the right arm end effector along the hinge arc and adjust the wrist as needed. Avoid sustained vertical lifting or sideways twisting.
- As the target opening is reached, reduce the movement size and check that the lid remains open. Avoid pulling the right arm back sharply right away; keep the end effector near the reference position for the open lid.
